text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P1 active PHRF epic. The live graph correctly closes through PHRF-16 and keeps required provider/trial/readout/calibration/performance tasks at P1. Already closed condition/shared-contract children are credited, not reopened by the old sentence that all implementation children remain open. Current trial outputs remain refused on the condition path, so the unified epic cannot close on condition-only evidence. Preserve scientific normalization/identity/rank, resource, independent oracle and admission constraints; apply finite-state-specific acceptance only if that backend is admitted. Canonical current work-item map is docs/plans/profile-hrf-work-items-v2.md, with PHRF-29 as the required sibling-plan/executor integration.
